name: blog-schema
description: > Generate complete JSON-LD schema markup for blog posts with Article/BlogPosting, Person, Organization, BreadcrumbList, ImageObject, and optional FAQPage. Validates against Google requirements and warns about deprecated types. Use when user says "schema", "blog schema", "json-ld", "structured data", "schema markup", "generate schema".
author: AgriciDaniel
summary_zh: 用于为博客文章生成符合 Google 要求的完整 JSON-LD 结构化数据，适合提升搜索引擎识别与展示效果。
